explication: The Modrinth monorepo contains the website, desktop app, API, and shared libraries. For the desktop app, users manage Minecraft instances, install content, and access instance features; the frontend and native Rust layer divide that experience. The API exposes platform services, while the website is a separate product. README evidence establishes these products but not their runtime connections. The sampled API route shows OAuth-client operations using persistence and authentication; other unsampled capabilities are represented by their source directories without inferred call flows.
